gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-009 challenges the operator theorem through cancellation for sign-changing sources even when T# is coercive, whereas the gold issue is the specific failure of applying the old theorem at κ=0 because Im T=0 is not injective. The prediction does not recognise the endpoint-specific self-adjoint alternative or the need to verify Re T injectivity and coercivity there.

Both identify that the pure exponential test function is not in the L²(D) volume-source range: bounded-domain integrability gives an entire Fourier transform that decays on the real axis, while equality with the unit-modulus exponential on an open interval would extend analytically and contradict decay. Thus the exact range criterion and its limiting inference fail.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The pure exponential used in the range criterion cannot belong to Range(L) for the stated L²(D) source model, so finite-dimensional or limiting range membership cannot establish the claimed exact membership.

component_coverage.gold_component: The asserted equivalence between membership of the geometric point and membership of the pure exponential in Range(L) fails because the exponential is not an attainable L²(D) volume-source output; consequently the exact-range inference is invalid.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 directly gives the same bounded-domain Fourier-decay and analyticity contradiction and explicitly concludes that the range-limit inference in lem3.4 is invalid.
